abstract: Early identification of high risk molar pregnancy is important in preventing the development of subsequent postmolar trophoblastic disease (PMTD). In the present study, evaluation of risk factors of developing PMTD, and indications for initiating prophylactic chemotherapy, and investigation of the effects of prophylactic chemotherapy were undertaken. One hundred and forty complete molar pregnancies treated at Yonsei University College of Medicine were retrospectively analyzed. Thirty-six cases of PMTD developed in these molar pregnancies during follow-up. Risk factors for PMTD were ranked according to frequency with which they were associated with PMTD. The patients with no risk factors were classified in the low-risk group, with one or two in the medium-risk group, and with three or more in the high-risk group. Prophylactic chemotherapy was administered to 14 of 52 low-risk, to 21 of 46 medium-risk, and to 17 of 42 high-risk patients. Among the high-risk patients, the time required for remission was significantly shorter in the group with prophylactic chemotherapy (13.5 weeks) than in the group without prophylactic chemotherapy (22.4 weeks). There were no differences in the duration until remission among the low- and medium-risk patients. Of the 52 patients who received prophylactic chemotherapy, 8 (15.4%) developed PMTD. Among the high-risk patients the occurrence of PMTD was significantly lower in the prophylactic chemotherapy group. Among the low-risk and medium-risk patients, there were no differences in the occurrence of PMTD between the chemoprophylaxis treated and untreated groups. Our results strongly support the use of prophylactic chemotherapy for patients that were designed under our high risk criteria. Prophylactic chemotherapy helps to prevent or reduce the risk of developing PMTD, and shorten the time required for complete remission in high-risk patients.
abstract_ja: ハイリスク胞状奇胎を早期に識別することは、その後の奇胎後絨毛性疾患(PMTD)の発症を予防するうえで重要である。本研究では、PMTD発症のリスク因子を評価し、予防的化学療法の適応と効果を検討した。延世大学医学部で治療された完全奇胎妊娠140例を後方視的に解析した。追跡期間中に、これらの奇胎妊娠のうち36例でPMTDが発症した。PMTDとの関連頻度に従ってリスク因子を順位付けした。リスク因子を有さない患者は低リスク群、1〜2個は中等度リスク群、3個以上は高リスク群に分類した。予防的化学療法は、低リスク52例中14例、中等度リスク46例中21例、高リスク42例中17例に投与された。高リスク患者では、予防的化学療法を受けた群の寛解までの期間(13.5週)は、受けなかった群(22.4週)より有意に短かった。低リスクおよび中等度リスクの患者では寛解までの期間に差はなかった。予防的化学療法を受けた52例中8例(15.4%)がPMTDを発症した。高リスク患者では、予防的化学療法群でPMTDの発生が有意に少なかった。低リスクおよび中等度リスク患者では、予防化学療法の有無によるPMTD発生の差はなかった。我々の結果は、本施設の高リスク基準に該当する患者への予防的化学療法の使用を強く支持するものである。予防的化学療法は、高リスク患者でのPMTD発症のリスクを予防または低減し、完全寛解までの期間を短縮するのに役立つ。
